sca_session_token.description: SCA session token from a prior call to bind a previously approved SCA challenge to this retry. When set, no polling occurs and the operation runs exactly once with the token attached.

wait.description: Maximum seconds (0-120) to poll inline for SCA approval before returning a structured pending response. Use false or 0 for a pure two-step flow (return immediately on SCA required). Default 30.

tools.name: bulk_transfer_create
tools.description: Create a bulk SEPA transfer from a debit account. Each item provides either beneficiary_id (existing) or beneficiary (inline name+iban). client_transfer_id is auto-generated when omitted; vop_proof_token is auto-resolved via bulk_verify_payee when omitted (and sca_session_token is not provided). SCA: this operation may require Strong Customer Authentication; the tool polls inline by default (wait=30s) and falls back to a structured pending response so the caller can continue via sca_session_show + sca_session_token.

client_transfer_id.description: Client-generated UUID for this item (auto-generated if omitted)

amount.description: Transfer amount (number or string with up to 2 decimals)

beneficiary_id.description: Existing beneficiary UUID (mutually exclusive with beneficiary)

beneficiary.description: Inline beneficiary (mutually exclusive with beneficiary_id at the item level)

items.description: A single transfer item within the bulk request

vop_proof_token.description: VoP proof token from bulk_verify_payee covering exactly the IBANs in this batch (auto-resolved when omitted, except on SCA retry)

sca_session_token.description: SCA session token from a prior call to bind a previously approved SCA challenge to this retry. When set, no polling occurs and the operation runs exactly once with the token attached.

wait.description: Maximum seconds (0-120) to poll inline for SCA approval before returning a structured pending response. Use false or 0 for a pure two-step flow (return immediately on SCA required). Default 30.
